effectiveModel: Uniform deterministic bit algorithm with worst-case running time.

reader.label: Effective little-o bound in the treewidth

sourceBasis.step: Discard the supplied path decomposition. On the reduction outputs the intrinsic treewidth t is at most the supplied width p. The maximum of an effectively little-o exponent over widths up to p is still effectively little-o at the same scale, and the graph-only input is no larger than the supplied-decomposition input.

statement: Under FPT ≠ W[1], no deterministic algorithm decides Vertex-Disjoint Paths within the stated running time.
